summary: 45-minute podcast with S. Naren (Executive Director & CIO, ICICI Prudential AMC; oversees ~Rs 12.4 lakh crores) on 36 years of investing: contrarian investing, market cycles, asset allocation (investing = buying, sizing, switching), and his valuation-cycle-sentiment-trigger framework. Key contrarian rotations: take money out of US Nasdaq into Japanese government bonds; in India rotate from small/midcap into large cap; private banks are cheap and investable; be careful of US AI growth stories and quick-commerce disruption risk in FMCG. Calls: JGB BUY; NASDAQ 100 SELL; INDIA SMALL/MIDCAP SELL; INDIA LARGE CAP BUY; INDIA PRIVATE BANKS BUY; US AI STOCKS SELL.
